name: Andrei Sakharov
role: Soviet nuclear physicist and human rights activist
contribution: A Soviet physicist and a Nobel Peace Prize laureate, which he was awarded in 1975 for emphasizing human rights around the world.
image_credit: Vladimir Fedorenko / Владимир Федоренко · CC BY-SA 3.0

checks.lead: Andrei Dmitrievich Sakharov (Russian: Андрей Дмитриевич Сахаров; 21 May 1921 – 14 December 1989) was a Soviet physicist and a Nobel Peace Prize laureate, which he was awarded in 1975 for emphasizing human rights around the world.
